rationale: The target and artefacts establish the braking-relevant situation and actual braking response as legitimate subjects of characterisation. However, the declared scope additionally includes obstacle detection itself, an enabling observation function. Detection requirements and its use as the timing trigger in FR-7.1 establish its relevance to braking, but do not establish detection itself as part of the phenomenon required to evaluate omitted braking maneuvers.
determining_elements: “Braking-relevant driving situation” is supported by H-1's collision scenario and FR-7's requirement to brake to avoid obstacles.
“Braking response” and braking activation are supported by SG-1, FR-7 and FR-7.1; their inclusion is not itself an overextension.

The scope explicitly includes “obstacle detection,” extending P to an observation function rather than limiting it to the circumstances requiring braking and whether the required maneuver occurs. FR-7.2 and the detection-related timing requirements do not by themselves justify that inclusion.
